methodology.candidate_local_method: precompute all proper full C7 internal colorings and project compatible boundary tuples under each partial precoloring
methodology.independent_local_method: direct DFS/backtracking separately for each of 64 boundary tuples and each partial precoloring; no reuse of candidate full-color table
methodology.global_sanity: For every ordered pair of the 70 distinct local relations on one common triple, compare brute-force four-state boundary assignment feasibility with the maximal-equality carrier.

symbolic_global_replay.maximality: For each variable, e_i^max is the largest equality bit realizable by its intersected unary domain.
symbolic_global_replay.necessity: Every feasible equality vector e satisfies e<=e^max coordinatewise.
symbolic_global_replay.sufficiency: Every clause relation is upward, so if any e satisfies all clauses then e^max satisfies all clauses; exact unary x equality factorization then supplies independent boundary states and stored local witnesses.
symbolic_global_replay.reconstruction: Clause gadgets are disjoint outside shared X/D boundary vertices; U colors are separated to {3,4}, X/D colors to {1,2}, so independently selected local witnesses combine exactly.
